workUnits.name: Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity
workUnits.purpose: Establish and validate the canonical Road LTL execution identity and information spine for downstream execution.
workUnits.trigger: Commercial offer or service request is accepted, or a governed transport-document/BOL instance requires creation, ingestion, amendment or validation for execution.

workUnits.name: Identify line-item object instances and hierarchy
workUnits.purpose: Identify line-item object instances and hierarchy

workUnits.name: Acquire governed BOL/document or API payload
workUnits.purpose: Acquire governed document/API evidence for the active Road LTL transaction.
workUnits.trigger: LTL-03 is triggered and governed document/API evidence is required.
atomicActions: Acquire available governed document/API evidence and retain provenance.
evidenceRequirements: Authority materiality determination: NOT_MATERIAL — this leaf acquires governed evidence and provenance; it does not decide source precedence, approve an exception, or exercise a business authority decision.
workUnits.outputState: Governed input evidence is available; missing information follows task-level exception policy.

workUnits.name: Validate input/document integrity
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether the acquired input is sufficiently intact for governed resolution.

blockingReasons: Frozen source requires input/document integrity validation but does not define terminal integrity criteria.

workUnits.name: Resolve applicable document/regime context
workUnits.purpose: Classify the active transport-document/regime context before applying context-specific semantics.

blockingReasons: Frozen source requires document/regime classification but does not provide a complete decision rule.

workUnits.name: Instantiate canonical TransportDocument and Consignment
workUnits.purpose: Create canonical TransportDocument and Consignment and associate them.
workUnits.trigger: Applicable Road LTL context is established and canonical document/consignment instances do not yet exist.
atomicActions: Instantiate canonical TransportDocument and Consignment and associate the Consignment to the TransportDocument.
evidenceRequirements: Source evidence establishing the document/consignment instances and association.
Authority materiality determination: NOT_MATERIAL — this leaf instantiates and associates canonical objects after context is established; it does not exercise discretionary or precedence authority.
workUnits.outputState: Canonical TransportDocument and Consignment exist and are associated.
